## Highlights
### Improved
- Show webpages as soon as they begin loading, with clear progress while content arrives - Improve extension compatibility across background messaging, notifications, page menus, and installation
### Fixed
- Keep the Start Page cohesive when opening a new tab - Keep software update progress and actions in the sidebar, with release notes available on demand - Play direct audio and video file links reliably across browser windows and devices - Show visited links accurately across websites without exposing each Space's history to webpages - Keep tab and folder dragging accurate while scrolling long sidebar lists - Launch reliably and keep Start Page searches and newly opened tabs responsive on iPhone and iPad
---
Development builds contain the newest changes and may be less reliable than stable releases.
